name: parsifly-web-app-definition-project
description: This extension define how a web app project is.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode buildOnly && (cd ./views/ui-editor && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode buildOnly) && (cd ./views/text-editor && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode buildOnly)
scripts.dev: concurrently -k --prefix-colors auto --names extension:build,ui-editor:build,text-editor:build,extension:serve "yarn extension:build:watch" "yarn ui-editor:build:watch" "yarn text-editor:build:watch" "yarn extension:serve"
